releases.title: Automation grows up: folders, smarter nodes, live preview
releases.warning: The Automation module is still young — review a workflow's first runs before trusting it with important files.

sections.title: New
entries: Organize automations in a folder tree with search, drag & drop, right-click actions (Windows-style menu), inline rename, and one-click cleanup of empty folders — the AI can organize too (create/move/list).
New Drive input node: the workflow can ask which drive to use when it runs (run form or AI), and any Drive field accepts {{ nX }} references to it.
New data nodes: multi-key table join, table union (distinct/all), table minus, table pivot, HTTP fetch, text splitter, folder listing and file copy.
Conditions now support several AND/OR comparisons in one node, with the legacy single comparison kept working.
Notebook inputs can now read one specific cell instead of the whole notebook.
validate_workflow: the AI checks a workflow without running it — every problem, field and fix hint up front; failed runs explain what to fix.
Live preview animations: wires flow while a preview runs, nodes light up green/red in execution order, and the run page has an animated progress bar.
A 'What's new' page (this one) is linked from the user menu with the running version.

sections.title: Improved
entries: Node settings popups redesigned: only essential fields up front, the rest under Advanced, required badges, one-click Try examples, readable help, and Done validates before closing.
Node cards redesigned with status dots, kind labels and Yes/No branch chips; bigger touch-friendly sockets.
The automations page fits on screen: compact header, dismissible notice, internal scrolling lists and a full-width canvas editor on mobile.
API keys for AI connections are now stored encrypted; session cookies hardened (HttpOnly, SameSite).
Markdown from files and AI answers is sanitized before display; image captions are downscaled before upload.

sections.title: Fixed
entries: Fresh installs no longer fail on the automation migrations (missing users table) and recover cleanly from interrupted startups.
Searching '*' no longer crashes the AI agent; database-is-locked contention is retried with backoff.
Canvas wires no longer appear detached when an automation is first opened — they redraw until the layout settles.
The node settings Cancel button always closes the popup, even if the editor script hasn't finished wiring it.
Duplicate-workflow badge shows in both grid and list views.

releases.title: Automation, behaviors & personas
releases.warning: The Automation module is in a very early stage — use it with care. Workflows may misbehave, node configs may change between releases, and runs can fail midway. Keep a copy of anything important before letting a workflow modify it.

sections.title: New
entries: Automation module: visual workflow editor with input, AI, transform, logic and output nodes — build pipelines by dragging nodes on a canvas.
Workflow runs: live run page with progress bar, per-node output popups, execution console, durations (ms/s/m/h) and an inputs & outputs reference section.

Behaviors & personas are now a core feature: manage reusable AI instructions on the Behaviors page (Profile → Behaviors & personas), including the bundled Agency persona library with per-persona and per-division enable/disable toggles.
Chat: the workflow open in the Automation editor appears as a context chip (like the current file), so the AI can inspect and edit it directly.
Chat: background tasks now stream live in the chat that launched them — no need to close and reopen the window.
Drive: rubber-band (lasso) selection — drag from empty space to select many files and folders at once (hold Ctrl/Cmd to add to the selection).

sections.title: Improved
entries: Chat context chips now refresh automatically when you navigate, so they always match what is on screen.
Automation index reorganized: collapsible examples, your workflows, and recent runs with status.
Persona previews render as formatted markdown instead of raw text.

sections.title: Fixed
entries: Drive: multi-select, drag & drop and right-click menus broke after the first page navigation — the page script now survives SPA navigation.
Indexing: 'database is locked' errors under parallel sync workers are retried instead of crashing the job.
Chat: the AI can use Automation tools again when the module is enabled (namespaced tools were invisible to the model).

sections.title: New
entries: Trash bin: deleted files land in the trash and can be restored or purged from the profile page.
Long-horizon background AI tasks with a dock widget, stop button and per-task event stream.
File version history: uploading or editing creates versions, with text diffs and one-click restore.

sections.title: New
entries: Personal searchable file drive: upload, OCR, full-text search and AI chat over your own files.
Multiple drives, folders, hashtags, duplicate detection and synced (read-only) local folders.
Docker and local install scripts, install guide and first-admin-user creation.
